```yaml
name: Test Flake

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'flake.nix'
      - 'flake.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/test-flake.yml'
      - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'flake.nix'
      - 'flake.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/test-flake.yml'
      - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action@v12

      - name: Cache Nix store
        uses: DeterminateSystems/magic-nix-cache-action@v7

      - name: Run nix flake check
        run: nix flake check

      - name: Test dev shell initialization
        run: nix develop --command echo "Dev shell initialized successfully"
```
